body_text:
An equivalence relation on $X$ and a partition of $X$ determine
one another. Equivalence classes form a partition; conversely,
declaring two elements equivalent when they lie in the same block
produces an equivalence relation. Quotienting therefore formalizes
the act of forgetting distinctions within blocks.
